title: Non-hashable static arguments are not supported.
author: lockwo

comments.author: patrick-kidger
comments.body:
This is intentional / I think for the best.

Better for us to delegate to the underlying `__hash__` implementation of any wrapped classes, rather than just bypassing them altogether. (I think I've had at least a few use-cases for this in exceptional cases.)

If need be this should be solveable in userland by wrapping unhashable types like dictionaries with a module whose `__hash__` method flattens-and-hashes its leaves.

comments.author: lockwo
comments.body: Fair enough, I just wanted to make sure since it was a breaking change
